name: Unica
source:
The protagonist, who's the eldest daughter of a noble family and grew up not knowing true love, began seeing a younger boy, despite already being engaged since childhood.
One day, she heard news of a murder incident that targeted young noblewomen----

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26981]Freem![/url]]
